content: App Store HealthKit rejection triggers: (1) Using HealthKit data for advertising/marketing or passing to ad SDKs — immediate rejection under guideline 5.1.3(i). (2) Privacy nutrition label in App Store Connect must declare Health & Fitness data categories; failure to declare causes rejection. (3) Missing or vague NSHealthShareUsageDescription and NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription strings. (4) Writing false/inaccurate data to HealthKit. (5) Storing HealthKit data in iCloud (prohibited). (6) Missing privacy policy URL that explicitly states health data is not used for advertising. Enhanced scrutiny on health apps means reviewers check data governance. Third-party SDKs (analytics) that receive HealthKit data are a violation even if unintentional.
